fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-08-03, the complainant reported repeated harassment by a neighbour over a traffic incident near Nallur Garden Residential Colony. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-08-03 at approximately 16:10. Elango Krishnan approached Coimbatore North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000081. Senthil Krishnan (mobile 9000000461) was named as a possible person of interest. Madhan Murugan was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. Items referenced in the complaint: a witness statement and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Neighbour allegedly used abusive language during a continuing dispute.
fields.Keywords: harassment, neighbour dispute, witness, witness statement, mobile number, CCTV, afternoon, residential colony
